key_facts: ECG shows sinus bradycardia with prolonged P-wave duration
ECG shows biphasic P wave morphology in leads II, III, and aVF

raw.rationale: The patient's ECG shows sinus bradycardia with prolonged P-wave duration, biphasic P wave morphology, and a PR interval of 280 milliseconds, which are indicative of sinoatrial node dysfunction, a hallmark of Sick Sinus Syndrome. The presence of atrial flutter on follow-up ECG further supports this diagnosis.
